Tonight I finished the 2nd to last draft of my next #JusticeHustlers #FeministHeist novel #SideChickNation about #HurricaneMaria. All that’s left is to read the whole thing aloud next week.

I feel good about the novel. I said what I needed to about #colonization+#ClimateChange.

1/3) This morning I turned in the final draft of #SideChickNation my novel about #colonization #climatechange+#HurricaneMaria. Early on I felt I wasn't good enough to tell this critical story about my people. The "right person" would have been universally lauded by the community.

My next #JusticeHustlers novel #SideChickNation comes out in June via @KensingtonBooks, the first novel about Hurricane Maria. About a formerly pimped Dominicana turned sugar baby caught in the storm in Puerto Rico+gets politicized about  #colonization+#climatechange. #ReadLatinx https://t.co/xhXqefYWHi
thanks to @dreamhampton, they up here at UCBerkeley law school talking about #SurvivingRKelly as leading a third wave of #MeToo that centers Black Women. https://t.co/X5UTcDCz7m
Getting good news from @rgay that Sony FINALLY dropped #RKelly as she’s up here at UCBerkeley law school talking about #MeToo⁠. https://t.co/jxrlAmvvXM
.@rgay on Kavanaugh at her #MeToo talk at UC Berkeley law: "I went to Yale. We went to [his fraternity] when we wanted to go drinking. I was like, 'he did it.'"

.@rgay at UC Berkeley talking about #MeToo talking about problems w/ relying on the legal system for justice in sexual violence. She wants justice to be "victim-based. When people say they paid their debt to society, I wonder, have you paid your debt to the person you wronged?" https://t.co/DitIj9WE8s

.@rgay talking about #MeToo here at UC Berkeley, fields a question about sexual violence in war+colonization/women being shamed. "Until women are valued as she would be valued, rape will continue to be used in colonization+war and women will continue to bear the shame of rape." https://t.co/FizEjxE8mK
